info.title: Aangan Studio phone-enquiry API
info.description: Backend contract for the Aangan Studio phone-enquiry MVP. Demo data and sample business rules; simulated calls are labelled. UUID ids, UTC ISO-8601 timestamps, INR in integer paise. Errors use { code, message, request_id, details }. No endpoint returns customer-facing prices.

get.description: Paginated inbox. Row-level security limits designers to assigned leads.
Facts with evidence, missing fields, calls and transcripts (role-restricted), qualification history, escalation flags, bookings, CRM sync, handoffs and outcomes.

patch.description: Send the lead `version`; a stale version returns 409 version_conflict. Optional If-Match must equal the body version (412 otherwise). Designers cannot reassign or override qualification. Fact edits trigger a recorded reassessment; the original automatic assessment is kept.

post.description: Assigned designer (or front desk for queue handoffs, or an administrator). 201 on first acceptance, 200 with already_acknowledged=true on repeats.
Append-only. contract_value_paise only with outcome=won and is not collected revenue. Optional Idempotency-Key header.

get.description: Staff JWT, or the voice service bound to the current call. Voice callers only see slots for qualified leads.

post.summary: Book (caller-confirmed) or record a declined consultation
post.description: 201 confirmed (provider booking id present); 202 pending_reconciliation (timeout; NOT booked); 409 slot_unavailable with alternatives; 502 provider rejected (NOT booked). Idempotent on idempotency_key.

get.description: Metrics with numerators/denominators and definitions; null rates for zero denominators; costs for administrators only.

post.summary: Create and validate a draft policy
post.description: Administrator only. Invalid drafts are stored with their validation issues and cannot be published.

post.summary: Run a simulated call (unavailable in live mode)
Start an evaluator sandbox session (demo mode only)
post.description: Unauthenticated, rate-limited per IP. Returns a 4-hour token for a seeded demo identity. Sandbox sessions only see and change simulated leads, never see live calendar availability, and cannot edit policies or costs (403 sandbox_read_only). 404 in live mode.

post.summary: Start a live in-browser voice test (demo mode only)
post.description: Starts a Vaani WebRTC session with the studio's agent. Recorded as a simulated call (mock calendar, CRM and email) with live AI extraction. 503 when the voice bridge is offline or not configured. 3 per minute.

get.description: Bookings across leads, newest slot first. Row-level security applies (designers see their own leads). `confirmed` is true only with a provider booking id.

schema.description: Slot start on or after (bookings without a slot are always included)

get.description: For assigning designers and reviewing handoff recipients. Sandbox sessions see demo staff only.

post.summary: Record an invoiced cost for reconciliation

post.description: simulated: X-Aangan-Signature `sha256=<hex HMAC of raw body>`, normalised event body; returns the per-call tool session and agent context. vaani (Vaani AI): unsigned Vaani event body authenticated by `?token=`; live calls are registered by the BYOL bridge. Deduplicated by event id.
Monotonic: out-of-order events never regress a call. Terminal status enqueues finalisation.

post.summary: Record utterances, extract facts with evidence, get the next question
Deterministic qualification against the pinned policy
Create a human task (pricing, complaint, commitment, human request, urgent)
Request a handoff (server picks the recipient; delivered after the call)

post.description: Bearer DISPATCH_SECRET (or CRON_SECRET). Query: limit (<=100), time_budget_ms (<=20000). GET is accepted for Vercel Cron.

staffJwt.description: Supabase Auth access token (JWKS ES256/RS256 or legacy HS256). Roles come from public.staff, not token claims.

callToken.name: X-Aangan-Call-Token
callToken.description: Per-call token from the incoming webhook response

webhookSignature.name: X-Aangan-Signature
webhookSignature.description: Simulated provider: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>. Vaani AI events instead use the query parameter token=<VAANI_WEBHOOK_SECRET>.

persona.description: A seeded demo identity (designer = Asha, designer_b = Vikram, designer_c = Neha)

stage.description: Single inbox stage derived from the separate status fields
Single inbox stage derived from the separate status fields

version.description: Send back on PATCH for optimistic concurrency

display.description: Human-readable value; only `stated`/`confirmed` values are usable by rules

value.description: Typed value; budget in paise, area in square feet

quote.description: Verbatim caller words supporting the fact (null if transcription was declined)

confirmed.description: True only when the provider returned a booking id

possible_related_leads.description: Same phone number; never merged automatically

say.description: Approved script lines; a booking is announced as booked only when confirmed=true

daily.description: Contract addition: per-day counts for the period (same definitions as the totals)

rate.description: null when the denominator is zero

won_rate.description: null when the denominator is zero

basis.description: mixed = an invoice covers part of the period; the rest is estimated

invoice_covered_fraction.description: Share of the period covered by invoices (0-1)

variance_paise.description: Invoiced minus the estimate for the invoiced sub-period

costs.description: Administrators only; null with costs_restricted=true for other roles

missing_env.description: Variable NAMES only; values are never returned

sandbox.description: Evaluator sandbox session: simulated records only; configuration is read-only

token.description: Short-lived LiveKit token for this one room

confirmed.description: True only when the provider returned a booking id

tool_session.description: Per-call credential for the business tools; re-derivable, so retries get the same token

agent_context.description: Approved scripts and rules for the voice agent. Contains no pricing data.

evidence_id.description: For confirm steps: send back in `confirmations` with the caller's reply

say.description: Speak in order. Guaranteed free of prices, ranges, totals, discounts, tax terms and commitments.

recipient_kind.description: Chosen by the server from the approved roster; never by the AI
